title: EviDx: Evidence-Aware Active Diagnosis with Scaffolded LLM Agents
abstract: arXiv:2608.24570v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Clinical diagnosis is an active evidence-seeking process in which clinicians acquire evidence, update competing hypotheses, and decide when the available evidence is sufficient for diagnosis. Yet many medical diagnosis systems built around large language models (LLMs) still formulate diagnosis as static case-to-answer prediction, with limited support for evidence acquisition. Agentic LLMs offer a dynamic alternative through tool use and intermediate diagnostic trajectories, but existing systems often under-specify how patient evidence should be exposed, scaffolded, and controlled at runtime. translated_abstract: 临床诊断是一个主动的证据寻求过程，临床医生在此过程中获取证据、更新相互竞争的假设，并决定现有证据何时足以做出诊断。然而，许多围绕大语言模型（LLMs）构建的医学诊断系统仍将诊断视为静态的“病例到答案”预测，对证据获取的支持有限。智能体式LLMs通过工具使用和中间诊断轨迹提供了一种动态替代方案，但现有系统往往未能明确说明患者证据在运行时如何暴露、搭建脚手架并加以控制。我们引入了EviDx，一个基于证据感知的主动诊断框架，它将患者特定的诊断环境与临床诊断脚手架及观察者引导的运行时控制机制相结合。在EviDx中，$\mathcal{E}$-Synthesis从原始临床病例构建交互式环境；脚手架组织角色专业化的智能体、证据工具，
tldr: EviDx通过证据感知的主动诊断框架，结合患者特定环境、临床脚手架和观察者引导控制，实现了动态证据获取与假设更新的自动化诊断过程。
en_tdlr: EviDx enables evidence-aware active diagnosis by integrating patient-specific environments, a clinical scaffold, and observer-guided runtime control for dynamic evidence acquisition and hypothesis updating.
